hadith:
Oaths and Vows - Narrated Ibn `Abbas:

While performing the Tawaf around the Ka`ba, the Prophet (ﷺ) passed by a person leading another person by a hair-rope nose-ring in his nose. The Prophet (ﷺ) cut the hair-rope nose-ring off with his hand and ordered the man to lead him by the hand.
message:
# A Message of Compassion and Trust

When faced with uncertainty about life's circumstances, remember that Allah—An Naafi', The Bestower of Benefits—intends good for you and works all things for your ultimate welfare. Just as the Prophet (ﷺ) taught us to treat others with dignity and gentleness rather than harshness, approach both your challenges and your relationships with compassion, trusting that divine wisdom guides what unfolds. Place your faith in Allah's benevolence, knowing that even in unclear situations, His mercy encompasses all affairs.
name:
An Naafi’ - النَّافِعُ - The Bestower of Benefits

The name An Naafi' highlights the divine attribute of providing benefits and positive outcomes to the believers and all of creation. It emphasizes God's mercy and generosity, reflecting His role as a source of sustenance and care for humanity and the universe.
verse:
Al-Jinn - The Jinn - 72:10

Now, we have no clue whether evil is intended for those on earth, or their Lord intends for them what is right.
